name: AT-HUB boot-time root (vendor parseinfo.sh gawk hook)
description: Replaces the vendor /opt/etc/parseinfo.sh (executed as root by AT-HUB.service at every boot) with a signed-gawk hook that preserves the vendor target_version write and starts the tvroot runner (bridge + modules). Root at boot with no ghservice squat and no Developer Mode dependency; survives rootfs wipes/reinstalls since only the persistent rw /opt vdfs is touched. Uninstall: restore the module backup over /opt/etc/parseinfo.sh and reboot.
author: levkropp
